grouping: Invented scenario groups, not real source groups; wording variants within a group are correlated.
split_assignment: For each of seven safety themes, two scenario groups are development and two are frozen. Four boundary groups are split two and two. Split fixed before candidate tuning.

evaluation_plan.query_construction: Only prompt enters planner/retriever; no expected sections, family, group ID, or support refs enter the query.
multiple_authorities: All required targets present within top3
All required targets present within top5
All required targets present within top16
boundary_cases: No forced governing citation for insufficient facts or unrelated input
Explicit missing-corpus distinction for known absent authority
scope: Relevance to a denied or controlled condition is allowed; a retrieved citation is not a violation label.
No single-most-aligned requirement for multi-hazard or insufficient-facts prompts.
evaluation_plan.aggregation: Report raw counts and per-group means. Do not count three paraphrases as independent field examples. Report regressions and unresolved cases.
evaluation_plan.candidate_freeze: Record exact code and corpus hashes before inspecting frozen comparison prompts or labels. One matched baseline/candidate comparison; if inspected for tuning it becomes development data.
evaluation_plan.language: Mostly English with one Spanish development question and one French frozen-comparison question; report those separately instead of implying general multilingual validation.
evaluation_plan.best_match_acceptance: Score relevance acceptance separately: accepted supported matches on target cases and false accepted matches on no-authority/corpus-gap cases. Raw candidate presence does not establish support or a violation.

authoring_note: The comparison prompts, labels and comparison-only references stayed sealed until the candidate code and corpus were frozen. Public case files preserve every original field and label; only CRLF file line endings were normalized to LF.
release_note: These authored cases are now public regression fixtures. They are not independent field evaluation or reviewer-approved training labels. Later tuning against them makes them development data. The original frozen comparison and the later public wrapper verification are separate records.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 after replacing CRLF file line endings with LF; source text is otherwise unchanged.
